Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

1) There is a Tension in the ranks in play. Player B, who controls FBI
Special Affairs, is down to 1 pool. Player A's minion is acting and
burns one of player B's allies in combat.

How are Tension 's and FBI's effects ordered ?

2) When one of your vampires plays Bujo, do you get a vote for the
political card (in the ash heap) you use to call the vote (as if you
played it from hand) ? If not, can you discard a political card to
gain a vote during the referendum ?

thank you !

François
